daemon_ref.decision: A1 — pa-daemon is deposited as reference code (its ACP wire interface), never launched

lineage.rule: H-M2 — the adapter never imports the fork: std only, no pa-* dependency

rules: scope is Local by default; Global only on explicit request
a plan never mutates: callers re-read the harness store before applying
unknown rollback id errors (Refinement {id} not found)
rollback is inverse edits in reverse order, skipping non-applied edits
refinement never runs mid-cell; a scheduled refinement runs when the turn ends
name is required and unique among siblings
collect timeout_ms=0 returns a non-blocking snapshot; a timeout returns current snapshots, never an error
end_turn is terminal: no further assistant response; a second call errors, never silently no-ops

runtime_surface.decision: A2 — the Python runtime (prime-agent-runtime/) is a surface re-pointed at the single daemon, never a second daemon

telemetry.fork_default: ON in release builds (TelemetrySwitch::Default => true; endpoint only in non-debug builds)
telemetry.verdict: ABANDONED with the fork — 0 signal in the native port (NoopSink only, no endpoint, no install-id minting)
